The button next to Bewaren, in Bespreken and in the Netwerk panel, marks a relation or project as gone through with nothing to hand over. Its label "Niets bijzonders" didn't say that. After clicking it, the history showed "Besproken: niets bijzonders" with the stored body "Niets bijzonders" printed again underneath.

- The button now reads **Niets over te dragen**.
- The history shows a single line, "Besproken, niets over te dragen". The body is no longer printed for this kind of note.
- New notes store "Niets over te dragen" as their body. Older notes keep "Niets bijzonders" in the database, which only shows in the CSV export.
- The docs and test names are updated to match. The test now checks that the line shows once.

339 PHP tests and pint pass.
